name: OpenSIPS IMS Community Edition
description: Fully working IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) CSCF component compliant with 3GPP specifications for IMS and VoLTE integration. Includes P-CSCF, I-CSCF, and S-CSCF sub-components.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose.yml present with three CSCF services (pcscf, icscf, scscf). Designed to work with Dockerized Open5GS 4G/5G core networks.

eval_notes: 3GPP-compliant IMS CSCF implementation with Docker compose. Ideal for testing VoLTE call flows, IMS registration, and SIP signaling in a containerized 4G/5G environment.
